sources.title: Destiny 2 Project Sunrise Is Bringing Vaulted Strikes Back
sources.snippet: Destiny 2's fan-made Project Sunrise mod is now making content vault Strikes fully playable again, with Tree of Probabilities confirmed working including enemies, bosses, and full mechanics.

sources.title: Installing Sunrise · Sunrise
sources.snippet: The launcher downloads the game, installs Sunrise and the mission scripts, and starts the game. It also repairs and updates an existing install, including one made with the old installer.

sources.title: Kimi K2: The Original Open Model, and What to Use Now
sources.snippet: Kimi K2 Kimi K2 is the open model that put Moonshot AI on the map in July 2025. It was built for coding and for tasks where the AI works by itself with tools. Moonshot has since retired it from its own service, but anyone can still download and run it. Here is what it was, where it stands, and what to use today.
